name: Multi Thread Detector
description: Per-call threading watchdog, as an Attention agent-builder flow. Fires once per analyzed call, builds a cumulative MEDDPICC stakeholder map across the deal's calls, scores single-thread risk, and posts a targeted alert with multi-threading actions to the team channel when risk is Medium or higher. On import, set the connections and the placeholder ids (<...>). Schema matches Attention's agent builder (Activepieces); on a different platform use multi-thread-detector.md.

trigger.name: trigger
trigger.displayName: When one of my calls is analyzed

nextAction.name: assess_threading
nextAction.displayName: Build the stakeholder map and score threading risk

input.prompt: You are the Multi Thread Detector agent, working from THIS analyzed call (title: {{trigger.attributes.title}}) and every prior call on the same deal/account. (1) Build a cumulative stakeholder map: list every person from the prospect side who has participated, their title/role where stated, and which MEDDPICC role they most likely fill - Champion (coaches the rep, sets up meetings, shows urgency), Economic Buyer (budget authority, ROI/pricing, final sign-off), Technical Evaluator (integrations, security, architecture, API, implementation), Coach (shares org/process intel but does not advocate), End User (workflows, UI, training, daily use). (2) Score threading risk: Critical/single-threaded = only 1 stakeholder OR 1 role covered; High = 2 stakeholders but no Economic Buyer or no Champion; Medium = 3+ stakeholders but 2+ roles uncovered; Low = 4+ stakeholders covering at least Champion, Economic Buyer, and Technical Evaluator. If this is the first call on a new deal, set risk to 'Early Stage - monitor' instead of Critical and remind the rep to multi-thread early; if the only call was an inbound/intro call, do not alert and note 'First call - threading assessment will begin after additional calls.' (3) For each missing role, give a specific action tied to the pain discussed (e.g. missing Economic Buyer: 'Ask your contact who approves investments of this size, and propose a 20-minute executive briefing on ROI'). If titles were not stated, note 'Roles inferred - confirm titles with the rep'. Output the exact alert format in multi-thread-detector.md -> Output, including the Deal Threading Score (roles covered out of 5). Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype adjectives, one clear ask, keep a teammate's real voice. Use single stars for emphasis, never double stars. Only emit an alert when risk is Medium or higher; for Low Risk output exactly: 'Threading healthy - no alert needed.'

nextAction.name: post_alert
nextAction.displayName: Post the threading alert to the team channel
